svg.aria-label: Ask Sangam, the AI agent on my site. Example: What has Sangam built on his own? On his own: a credit risk model tuned to catch defaulters (0.76 ROC-AUC, 41.8% of defaulters caught at a 15% threshold), customer segments with K-Means served by FastAPI on AWS EC2, and a house price model that explains 83% of the variance. ProfilePilot and DealShield AI were built by AI coding assistants from his ideas, and he launched them.
